reasoning: On the season so far the Mavericks are the stronger team; with home court the Mavericks start about 5 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Mavericks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 66 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 205 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: The Clippers are 0-6 on the road and just lost to a three-win Utah team. Brandon Ingram is still out, with his debut reportedly targeted for Monday against Houston, and Bradley Beal has no timeline. Derrick Jones Jr. faces his former team. Dallas snapped a three-game skid by beating Golden State, have Kyrie Irving back, and Dusty May wants that physicality 'every night'. The angle leans towards Dallas.
